class.name: BatchingListUpdateCallback
class.brief_description: Coalesces adjacent update events into batches.
class.description: BatchingListUpdateCallback wraps a [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b] and merges adjacent events (consecutive inserts / removes / changes) so the wrapped callback receives the fewest possible calls. Used internally when dispatching a diff.

method.name: dispatch_last_event
method.description: Forwards the currently buffered event to the wrapped callback.

method.name: get_last_event_count
method.description: Returns the count of the buffered event.

method.name: get_last_event_position
method.description: Returns the position of the buffered event.

method.name: get_last_event_type
method.description: Returns the type of the buffered event.

method.name: on_changed
method.description: Feeds a change event into the batch.

method.name: on_inserted
method.description: Feeds an insert event into the batch.

method.name: on_moved
method.description: Forwards a move event immediately (moves never batch).

method.name: on_removed
method.description: Feeds a remove event into the batch.

members.member: The underlying [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b] receiving the coalesced events.
